purpose: Preserve receipted temporal sequences of PREMAQ state evolution anchored to real-world time markers. DEEPTime answers when and at what rate — not what was witnessed (DEEPStory) and not what patterns emerged (DEEPTheory).
governing_rule: Story records what happened. Theory records what is known. Time records when, in what order, and at what spiral coordinate the accepted state moved.

time_anchor_baseline.utc_source: system clock or Observer packet timestamp
time_anchor_baseline.julian_date_source: computed from UTC via CODATA reference
time_anchor_baseline.moon_phase_source: astronomia or equivalent library; illumination fraction
